Lead Electrical Engineer

Canada, Toronto

Academic Bachelor

> 10 Years

Lead electrical design activities for mining and metals projects, including power distribution systems, substations, and related infrastructure. Perform equipment sizing and selection for key electrical components such as transformers, generators, drives, switchgear, MCCs, UPS systems, cables, and grounding systems. Support the development and continuous improvement of engineering standards, best practices, and technical guidelines. Prepare technical documentation, bid packages, and evaluation materials for electrical equipment and bulk materials. Produce core electrical engineering deliverables such as single-line diagrams, load lists, equipment datasheets, layouts, cable schedules, and design packages for execution. Provide leadership, mentorship, and technical oversight to junior and intermediate team members. Contribute to engineering studies, technical reports, and design reviews, including evaluation of alternative approaches. Promote collaboration and high performance through coaching, knowledge sharing, and day-to-day support. Coordinate with clients, vendors, and multidisciplinary teams to support successful project delivery. Manage electrical discipline activities to align with project scope, schedule, and budget requirements. Ensure applicable codes, standards, and project requirements are reflected in the design. Work closely with other engineering disciplines to resolve technical issues and coordinate design interfaces. Support quality assurance and quality control activities throughout the design process. Work with stakeholders to identify technical challenges and develop practical solutions. Use engineering tools, software, and reference materials effectively to support accurate and efficient design work. Provide guidance to junior and intermediate engineers and designers across project phases.

Project Controls Manager

Usa

Professional Bachelor

> 10 Years

Brunel is currently searching for a Project Controls Manager for a long-term contract position located in Miami, Arizona with our mining client. Will consider non-local candidates on a 4x1 rotation (4 weeks working at site, 1 week off at home. If the project workload supports working from home during the "off" week, it must be with manager approval.)DESCRIPTION:Manages and oversees project controls functional area for very large multidisciplinary high risk capital engineering and construction projects. Responsible for project planning and scheduling, cost estimating and monitoring, progress measurement, risk management and reporting. Manages project controls personnel. Responsible for establishing operating policies to mitigate risk. Provides guidance and consultation for project managers and corporate management. Experienced with a variety of the field's concepts, practices, and procedures. Relies on extensive experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals. This position is "hands on" or working manager position.DUTIES: * Guide and direct resolution of project difficulties and complex project control issues. Strong analytical skills required to review all project controls information and ensure accuracy as well as identify issues, concerns and potential mitigations. * Interact with the Project Management team and Corporate management team and participate in regular project meetings. Gather information and prepare reports and presentations of information as needed on the project. * Identify and communicate design changes, scope changes and schedule slippages and potential impacts and participate in the identification of mitigations. Ensure trends of cost and schedule are identified, manage change management process and communicate and suggest corrective actions.* Coordinate with cross functional team in project setting, ensure project controls team members are interfacing with engineering, procurement, contracts and construction on concepts and relationships to the scope of work and ensure adherence to safety and quality standards.* Oversees project baseline process for cost, schedule and progress and ensure all project systems are implemented according to process and company standards and procedures. * Ensure full implementation of company processes and procedures as well as industry best practices with regards to project controls on the project following the company project stage gate process. * Establish risk management protocol which includes identification, documentation, mitigation and tracking of potential risks on the project. Determine potential cost and schedule/progress impacts of potential risks as they are identified. * Ensure the accuracy of reported progress percentage based on the rules of credit established within the project. Develop progress measurement process for required scopes of work.* Establish and manage project schedule development, review and update processes and to ensure accuracy and alignment with the overall master schedule.* Manage and ensure all project required reporting is pared and submitted as per approved reporting schedule for the project.* Mentor and lead a large staff of project controls team members, ensure project is staffed appropriately, conduct regular staff performance reviews and manage any staffing issues that may arise. JOB SCOPE:* Nature of work: Works on highly complex issues and responsible to implement solutions. Leads and directs the work of others. A wide degree of creativity and latitude is expected. * Level of interaction: Leads the department with interaction with external piers in various departments, responsible for cross coordination between groups. * Autonomy/decision making: Works under very limited to no supervision and has latitude to set objectives, priorities and timelines. * Budgetary responsibility: Has moderate budgetary responsibility. * Managerial responsibility: Leads large multidisciplinary project controls team. REQUIREMENTS:* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business or related fields and twelve (12) years' experience in Construction Management, at least eight (8) years of experience in a leadership role in project controls * OR High School diploma or GED and sixteen (16) years' experience in engineering, construction, project controls or business related field with at least eight (8) years of experience in a leadership role in project controls.* Leadership ability and strong management skills.* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Word, Excel and Outlook.* Strong communication skills both verbal and written.* Strong analytical skills.* Ability to multi-task in a high paced project environment.* Experience with ERP system, estimating software, SAP and EcoSys is preferred.* Understanding of accounting functions and systems.* Experience with cost control including project estimating, forecasting and cost management including reporting.* Strong understanding of Primavera and with overall planning process and best practice on capital mining projects. * Construction experience with an ability to maintain awareness of occupational hazards and safety precautions in a construction environment. * Experience with mining construction projects preferred.* MUST be eligible to work in the U.S. for any employer without sponsorship.OFFER:Position will be paid on a day rate based on experience. This position will be a 4x1 rotation at site in Morenci, AZ. All travel expenses, transportation, accommodations and monthly stipend paid for by the client as well as all reasonable expense items reimbursed per company guidelines/policies. Contractors through Brunel will be eligible for full benefits starting your first day of employment. This role includes a 3% 401K match. This position will be subject to background checks, drug/alcohol screening and fit for duty physical. OUR CLIENT:Our client is a global mining company.

Reliability Specialist

Canada, Kitimat-stikine

Academic Bachelor

> 10 Years

* Provide frontline reliability support for day-to-day operational and equipment performance issues.* Facilitate root cause investigations and problem-solving activities using appropriate reliability and incident investigation methodologies.* Conduct bad actor reviews and develop strategies to eliminate repeat equipment and process failures.* Analyze operational and maintenance data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for reliability improvement.* Develop insights and recommendations using reliability tools and analytical techniques such as Pareto analysis.* Support the continuous improvement of asset and equipment care plans.* Work closely with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, and Technical teams to improve plant performance and reliability.* Support site reliability programs by identifying, prioritizing, and mitigating reliability threats and opportunities.* Coach and mentor engineers, technicians, supervisors, and other stakeholders in reliability best practices and problem-solving techniques.* Promote a proactive defect elimination culture across the organization.* Support the development of reliability reports, presentations, and performance metrics for management and operational stakeholders.* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, production, reliability, and asset performance.* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to develop and implement sustainable solutions to technical and operational challenges.

Camp Supervisor - Bagdad

Usa

Professional Bachelor

6-9 Years

Manage the camp facility to provide the standards set by the company, including alignment of project activities to business goals, financial and resource allocation, and to audit and control the performance of the camp services provider. Manage the planning and execution of the project camp schedule to align with the Project schedule. Work with the camp services provider to fully implement the camp rules and regulations. Establish and manage camp services for all phases including transportation, accommodation, catering, offices, IT etc. Oversee the camp services provider's performance to ensure compliance with the contract and to ensure high standards of service including and not limited to housekeeping/catering /waste management/medical facilities/transportation. Manage the monitoring and reporting of supplier's performance against all project support services contracts, work plans, quality of services and camp occupancy. Conduct hygiene and food safety inspections and immediately report any potential safety risks. Manage the camp booking system including the check in/Check out procedures for both mob and de-mob. Perform other relevant duties as requested.

Construction Superintendent (Structural)

India

Professional Bachelor

Not applicable

Ensuring adherence to all safety protocols and regulations during fabrication process. Manages and ensures successful execution of CP Topsides structures fabrication project components to meet prioritized objectives (Safety, Quality, Schedule, and others, as appropriate). To supervise and control the activities of the Contractor/Subcontractors related to the Structure fabrication, Mechanical Completion to ensure that it complies with contractual requirements, project documentation and applicable International Standards. To assess the constructability aspects, as well as the compliance with all technical requirements, of the deliverables provided by the Engineering Team Contractor. To review deviations to LNG construction standards for comments with Contractors / Subcontractors input, to deliver a consistent dossier (documents, materials, procured and fabricated items, precom/com dossiers, as built …) for the construction activities. Identify any areas of concern with respect to progress and/or quality and recommend corrective actions as required. Review Contractor's progress reports and reports for all the activities, highlighting critical problems, drifts and dysfunctions if any. To Liaise with Contractors/Subcontractors for all structure subjects, MC, Pre-commissioning and Commissioning to ensure the Contractors/Subcontractors progress follow up and reporting. To Participate in Risk Assessments, kick off meetings and Pre-Job Meetings, technical meeting etc. as required in accordance with Company's referential.

Mechanical Engineer - Technical Cooling Loop

Canada, Calgary

Academic Bachelor

> 10 Years

Own the complete mechanical technical solution for Technical Cooling System (TCS) infrastructure packages from concept through installation. Translate customer requirements into complete, buildable engineering solutions with clearly defined scope, interfaces, responsibilities, and deliverables. Lead the mechanical system design for piping headers, spool assemblies, valve trains, filtration systems, buffer and expansion tanks, drip trays, leak detection integration, and related mechanical infrastructure. Serve as the principal mechanical design authority on awarded projects while coordinating external engineering resources when specialized expertise is required. Lead detailed mechanical design activities for complex liquid cooling systems. Perform and oversee engineering analyses including piping stress, fluid dynamics, thermal expansion, pressure systems, and mechanical loading. Apply engineering best practices including GD&T, design-for-manufacturing, tolerance analysis, and engineering release processes. Ensure designs satisfy functional, manufacturing, serviceability, reliability, and regulatory requirements. Lead engineering design reviews, technical decision-making, and design approvals. Provide technical direction and mentorship to supporting designers and engineers. Develop and oversee complete engineering documentation including: P&IDs 3D CAD models and fabrication drawings Installation and interface drawings Bill of Materials (BOM) inputs As-built documentation Installation readiness packages Identify engineering risks early through DFMEA, Single Point of Failure analysis, and other structured engineering methodologies. Drive corrective actions through failure investigations and root cause analysis. Support prototype development, validation, commissioning, and product improvements. Ensure engineering solutions are safe, reliable, and scalable throughout the product lifecycle. Collaborate closely with manufacturing, production, quality, and service teams during product launches. Support installation and commissioning by defining mounting requirements, structural loading, alignment, and mechanical interfaces. Troubleshoot complex production and field issues through system-level analysis and corrective action planning. Partner with Supply Chain on component selection, supplier support, and cost optimization initiatives. Work closely with project management, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and customer-facing teams. Coordinate external engineering consultants and specialized design resources when required. Support multiple concurrent engineering programs while maintaining quality, schedule, and technical excellence.

ES&H Professional

Usa, Houston

Academic Bachelor

Not applicable

Job Summary In this position, you will incorporate safety and health requirements into complex project planning, design activities, and operational processes to minimize potential risks and impacts. You will conduct risk assessments, contribute to bid reviews, lead meetings and communications, and monitor performance trends. Your recommendations will help improve the effectiveness of safety procedures and work practices. Major Responsibilities Supports the implementation of the safety portion of the ESH Program, including both technical and administrative elements. Assists in the development and execution of Safety and Health Management Plans, supporting procedures, and training programs. Provides guidance to Engineering, Construction, Procurement, Subcontracts, Commissioning, and other departments to ensure safety and health requirements are incorporated into project planning and execution. Interprets safety and health standards and delivers support in plan development, risk assessments, and ESH program implementation. Investigates moderately complex safety issues and regulatory requirements and prepares related reports and documentation. Assists with safety studies, risk evaluations, program assessments, and audit activities. Participates in emergency response efforts, incident investigations, and corrective action processes. Communicates and collaborates with stakeholders to address and resolve concerns. Takes part in meetings with clients, project teams, subcontractors, and other stakeholders. Performs ESH inspections and monitoring activities to identify hazards, assess risks, evaluate corrective measures and controls, and verify compliance with contractual, regulatory, project, and company requirements.

Administrator (Document Control)

Usa

Secondary School

4-6 Years

Reports to the Project Document Control Manager and Engineering Director, the document control specialist will manage all project documentation. He or she will provide complex and diversified document control support for the project. Responsibilities: Coordinate all Project documentation, ensuring the maintenance of files represents accurate and up to date information. Manage technical documentation and assist in establishing and implementing publishing standards compliance. Ensure system templates are effectively deployed on the Project. Oversee receipt and distribution of documents received by transmittal from the EPC Contractor's Document Control for correctness and completeness ensuring alignment with System templates, metadata and Document Distribution Matrix (DDM).

Survey Technician

Australia, Mooloolaba

Professional Bachelor

Not applicable

Prepare, maintain and update survey models, set out data and GPS files. Upload and manage survey data across survey instruments and machine control systems. Coordinate survey set out to support construction activities and project delivery. Review drawings and specifications to ensure survey accuracy and compliance. Maintain survey equipment registers and software updates. Support project teams by providing accurate survey information and technical assistance. Ensure survey activities are completed in accordance with project specifications and quality standards.

Senior Estimator | Construction

Australia, Brisbane

Secondary School

4-6 Years

As the Senior Estimator, you will be responsible for preparing accurate estimates, managing supplier and subcontractor pricing, controlling project budgets, and supporting projects from pre-construction through to construction. Prepare detailed cost estimates and quantity take-offs for residential projects. Review plans, specifications and project documentation. Source and negotiate competitive pricing from suppliers and subcontractors. Prepare and manage project budgets. Issue and manage purchase orders. Monitor project costs and identify cost-saving opportunities. Maintain estimating databases and current pricing. Liaise with consultants, suppliers, subcontractors and internal project teams. Support continuous improvement of estimating processes and procurement systems.

Australia

Coordinate project activities across engineering, procurement, installation, commissioning, and service teams. Monitor project progress and implement corrective actions to achieve project objectives. Scope, Cost & Schedule Management Manage project scope in accordance with contractual requirements. Develop and maintain project budgets, forecasts, and financial plans. Track project costs, revenue, and profitability. Ensure project milestones and deliverables are achieved within agreed timelines. Manage change orders and variations to maximize project performance.
